post: All six Serbian saints shipped in v9.0: St. Sava, St. Simeon the Myrrh-streaming, St. Basil of Ostrog, St. Lazar, St. Nikolaj Velimirovic, and St. Justin Popovic. Their profiles are live at /saints. Thank you for the recommendation. Closing the thread.

All five Romanian saints shipped in v9.0: St. Paisius Velichkovsky, St. Dumitru Staniloae, St. Cleopas of Sihastria, St. Sofian of Antim, and St. Arsenius of Prislop. Their profiles are live at /saints. Thank you for the recommendation. Closing the thread.
St. Theophylact of Ohrid has a live profile at /saints/theophylact-of-ohrid. Verbatim commentaries are in editorial review. Thank you for the suggestion. Closing the thread.
